description: kiln.eml.startup v1 native_terminal: kiln-sfi's native terminal for this launch, pushed once after every planned DLL reached its outcome (or the startup deadline passed, or the loader was never armed). kiln-eml reads it before its startup pass: a withdrawn package and its dependents get no startup data. kiln-eml refuses a record that fails this schema, whose planId is not the plan's, whose dlls are not attach's planned_dlls in number, or that names a package the plan does not list. Fields in this order. Writers clamp free text to its maxLength at a character boundary and chains to their first 64 entries; dlls and ids are never clamped (their bounds cover the plan reader's).

notArmed.description: The loader was never armed (conclude_without_loader: the native policy refuses, the plan has no DLL, the plan's native part cannot be read, or the loader thread could not start): no DLL reached the loader, every DLL is refused, the deadline did not pass and the run is coherent; withdrawn names every candidate that ships native code (a package that only registers DLLs from its Lua too) and their dependents. A run made at Kiln's plugin step (kiln-sfi's early phase did not run) has no attach, so it pushes no terminal. A refused or missing witness is an armed run whose DLLs are all refused, with coherent false.

deadlinePassed.description: The startup deadline passed before every planned DLL finished.

coherent.description: witness_recheck after the terminals. ok false carries the reason; kiln-eml's own check before its pass stays the authority.

withdrawn.description: Packages that will not run, in plan order: a DLL of the package did not load (refused, faulted, timed out or withdrawn), or a dependency was withdrawn (Lua-only packages too). A package can be withdrawn while an earlier DLL of it stays loaded. code is kiln-sfi's word (sfi-state's code grammar); kiln-eml writes such a package's outcome row as native-refused with this text and chain.

chain.description: The dependency chain from this package to the package that failed, nearest first (the failed package last); empty for that package itself; never its own id. A longer chain keeps its first 64 entries.

dlls.description: Exactly one per planned DLL (attach's planned_dlls), in plan order.

statusId.description: dll:<package folder>:<path>, lower case, as kiln-sfi's native plan names it.

outcome.description: loaded: this run loaded it. foreign-owned: another loader already had the same file (never initialized again). refused: refused before it could run. faulted: the load or its initializer failed. timed-out: not finished at the deadline. withdrawn: not attempted (an earlier DLL of its package or a dependency failed).

sfId.description: A ShroudForge identifier, as sfi-state.schema.json's sfId.

code.description: A stable machine word (kebab-case), as sfi-state.schema.json's code.

uuid.description: The launch plan's plan_id, canonical lower-case UUID text.
